Patch: replace [title='Open Search'] with getByRole('button', { name: 'Open Search' }) in openSearch(). After patching, TC-CS-021 should reach Step 22 and fail with ASSERTION_FAILURE (the designed-to-fail behavior), revealing the APP_DEFECT.
